# dsh-stl-viewer An **STL 3D preview** for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh) side card. Click any `.stl` in the [dsh-better-sidebar](https://github.com/H-h-Hh/dsh-better-sidebar) file tree and the file renders in place, with the controls of a normal 3D viewer. ``` left-drag orbit around the model wheel zoom right-drag pan (Shift + left-drag does the same; two-finger scroll zooms) double-click reset the view (the 复位视角 button and the R / 0 keys do too) measure click 测量 (or press M), then click two features — the cursor snaps to a vertex, an edge, a whole face or a circular rim, the way Bambu Studio's measure tool does. Shift-click takes an arbitrary point on the surface instead. Dragging still orbits, Esc or 测量 again leaves the mode ```

A 47,068-triangle gear cover (176 × 176 × 40 mm) in the real side card, next to the chat that produced it.

No viewer installed: “此文件类型不支持预览 / 下载查看”. With the plugin: a 2,912-triangle enclosure lid and a 17,136-triangle stencil, both in the side card.

点到点: the cursor snaps to the corner you are aiming at, the picked point is drawn as a dot on the model, and the readout carries the straight distance plus ΔX / ΔY / ΔZ: 58.0 mm across the diagonal of a plate, the two farthest corners the test could find.

面到面: click one face, then another. Coplanar triangles are flood-filled from the picked one, so you measure a real face — not one triangle — and two parallel faces give the gap between them: 36.0 mm here, with ΔX / ΔY / ΔZ underneath.

圆: hover a rim and the whole rim is one pick — here the 20 mm bore of a washer, with the 40 mm outer rim available as a second, separate pick. The panel in the top-left corner gives Ø and R (and, while measuring, the pair type plus ΔX / ΔY / ΔZ), the way Bambu Studio does it.

> **Why a separate plugin?** > DeepSeek Harness ships previews for text, images, PDFs and Markdown. Binary CAD > formats such as `.stl`, `.obj`, `.step` fall through to “this file type cannot be > previewed”. This plugin registers an `stl` file viewer on the `betterSidebar` > service, so `.stl` stops being an opaque blob. ## Features - **Binary and ASCII STL** — sniffed, not guessed from the extension: exact `84 + 50·N` size match first, then an ASCII scan, then a tolerant binary pass for files with trailing bytes - **Correct normals** — recomputed per facet; STLs in the wild carry zeroed or plainly wrong normals, and exported meshes often mix winding orders - **Two-sided shading** — `gl_FrontFacing` flips the normal, so inverted facets still read as solid rather than a black hole - **Z-up → Y-up** — CAD and 3D printing export Z-up; the viewer stands models upright instead of showing them lying on their back - **Frame-fit camera** — the orbit distance is derived from the bounding sphere and the FOV, so a 0.6 mm thick stencil and a 300 mm part both fill the panel on open - **Measure the way a CAD tool does** — the pointer snaps to a **vertex**, an **edge** or a whole **face**, like [Bambu Studio's measure tool](https://wiki.bambulab.com/en/software/bambu-studio/measure): corners within 12 px win over edges within 8 px, which win over the face underneath, and Shift-click takes an arbitrary point instead. Only real creases snap (boundary edges, or neighbours more than 20° apart), so a finely tessellated cylinder does not turn into a field of snapping edges. The pair decides what is measured — point/point is the straight distance, point/face the perpendicular distance, edge/edge the angle plus the gap, face/face the plane gap when parallel and the true shortest distance plus the angle when not — and every readout carries ΔX / ΔY / ΔZ. Picking is a ray–triangle intersection against the real mesh, and the numbers come from the raw file coordinates rather than the normalised render space, so they are the same numbers you would measure in CAD - **Circles are picked as circles** — a rim on a bore, a boss or a cylinder is a chain of very short creases, and edge snapping alone would only ever catch one facet of it. Hovering a rim therefore traces the loop and fits a circle to it, which turns the whole rim into a single pick: the 20 mm bore and the 40 mm outside of a washer are two separate features, so an inner and an outer diameter can be read on their own. The fit rejects what is not round (a hexagon is not a circle) and a chain that does not close - **A readout panel in the corner** — the picks are listed in the top-left corner the way Bambu Studio does it: `直径 Ø 20.0 mm` and `半径 R 10.0 mm` for a circle, the pair type and the distance for a measurement, with ΔX / ΔY / ΔZ underneath - **Themed** — transparent clear colour and `currentColor` chrome, so the panel follows the app's dark/light theme instead of stamping a white box on it - **No build step, no dependencies** — `lib/client.js` *is* the artifact ## Requirements - DeepSeek Harness `>= 0.2.0` - [dsh-better-sidebar](https://github.com/H-h-Hh/dsh-better-sidebar) `>= 0.30.0` — it owns the file tree, the tabs and the `betterSidebar` service this plugin registers into - A browser with WebGL 1 (everything current; the software rasteriser is enough) ## Install In DSH, or from the plugin manager page → *install from a local directory*: ``` plugin_manager install_bundle target: file:D:/path/to/dsh-stl-viewer ``` Then reload the page. Open any `.stl` from the file tree; if the file is already open in a tab as an unsupported binary, close that tab and click the file again. Uninstall: ``` plugin_manager remove_bundle target: dsh-stl-viewer ``` ## How it works The plugin is a bundle with a host half and a client half. | half | file | what it does | | --- | --- | --- | | host | `lib/index.js` | an empty Cordis plugin — it exists so the package enters the layer stack and its client script is served | | manifest | `package.json` | `dsh.bundle.patch` makes it a bundle, `exports["./client"]` + `dsh.client.platform: "web"` publish `/plugins/dsh-stl-viewer/client.js` | | patch | `cordis.patch.yml` | the one `insert:` line that puts the plugin in the layer stack | | client | `lib/client.js` | parse → normalise → WebGL → input → registration; a classic script, run by the DSH module loader, `require('react')` resolving to the host's React | Registration is one call, and the model bytes come from the sidebar's own route: ```js ctx.betterSidebar.registerFileViewer({ id: 'dsh-stl-viewer:stl', title: () => t('title'), icon: (size) => cubeIcon(size), exts: ['stl'], priority: 10, fetchStrategy: 'mediaUrl', // the host hands over the raw-bytes URL component: StlViewer }) ``` `fetchStrategy: 'mediaUrl'` means the viewer gets `mediaUrl` as a prop and does a plain `fetch()`, so no host RPC, no base64 over the wire. Everything after that is local: | step | detail | | --- | --- | | read | `fetch(mediaUrl, { credentials: 'same-origin' })` → `ArrayBuffer` | | parse | 80-byte header + `uint32` count + 50 bytes/facet, or `vertex x y z` triples (ASCII capped at 6 M numbers) | | normalise | centre on the bbox, scale to a max edge of 2, per-facet normals, Z-up → Y-up | | render | WebGL 1, three lights + specular, one `drawArrays`, redraws only on demand | The plugin also registers a cube file icon for `.stl`, so the file tree stops showing a generic blob. ## Notes and limits - **Sizes carry no unit.** STL stores bare numbers; the `size X × Y × Z` readout is the raw bounding box, not mm or inch. - **Measurements say `mm`, because CAD STL almost always is.** The number is the raw coordinate distance in the file; if your model is authored in inches, read it as inches. - **"A face" is a coplanar region, found by flood fill.** Curved surfaces are therefore many faces, which is what you want when measuring a flat pad against a plate, but a fillet is not a single face. Faces are grown along shared edges only, so a mesh with welded vertices gives the best regions. - **Snapping needs the crease topology, which is built on first use.** Finding corners and creases means an edge sweep over the mesh — 0.6 s for 47 k facets — so it happens the first time you hover in measure mode instead of when the file opens. Meshes above 400 k facets skip it and fall back to face picking. - **A circle is recognised, not assumed.** The rim must close (no turn sharper than 60° per step) and fit a circle within 2% of its radius, checked at the vertices, at the midpoint of every segment and against the rim plane — a 48-sided bore reads as round, a hexagon does not. Circles ride on the same crease topology as snapping, so they also wait for that first hover. - **Z-up is assumed.** Models authored Y-up will lie on their side. Axis guessing is deliberately left out — a wrong guess is more confusing than a predictable default. - **Large files are parsed whole.** A few hundred thousand facets take 1–2 s and one `drawArrays` call; there is no streaming and no LOD. - **STL only.** `.obj`, `.glb`, `.3mf` are out of scope. - **No WebGL → a message, not a white panel.** ## Tests ```bash node --check lib/client.js node test/smoke.cjs ``` `test/smoke.cjs` runs `lib/client.js` in a `vm` sandbox with a minimal React hooks stub and a replaceable `fetch`, and asserts the module contract, the viewer descriptor, a hand-built binary cube (12 facets, size 20), an ASCII single triangle, the three error paths (garbage bytes, empty file, failed fetch), the face-to-face geometry — plane fitting, point-to-triangle and triangle-to-triangle distance — and the feature topology: 8 corners and exactly 12 creases on a cube (the 6 in-plane diagonals do not count), plus point/segment/plane helpers. The circle fit gets its own group: a 24-gon traces back to its start and fits r = 10, a hexagon, a square and an open chain are all rejected, and a washer fixture yields exactly two rims, R10 and R20. No browser needed. `.github/workflows/test.yml` runs the same on every push. The end-to-end check uses a real renderer: `test/harness.html` mounts the component with React UMD builds, `test/shoot.cjs` screenshots it through a headless Electron (`--enable-unsafe-swiftshader --use-gl=swiftshader`). That is how the images above were produced. `test/measure.cjs` drives the same harness with synthetic pointer events: it looks up the screen pixels of the two plate faces through the viewer's `_test` handle, clicks 测量, clicks both faces, and asserts the label reads `36.0 mm` with `面到面 · 平行面间距`, that `_test.measure().parallel` is true, and that Esc clears everything again. The fixture `test/fixtures/plates.stl` comes from `test/fixtures/make-plates.cjs`: two 80 x 60 mm plates 36 mm apart, the top one covering half of the bottom one. The same fixture doubles as the snapping check: `test/snap-points.cjs` scans the canvas for pixels that snap to a `point`, picks the two farthest apart and asserts the label reads `58.0 mm` — the diagonal of the top plate — with ΔX 40 / ΔY 0 / ΔZ 42. `test/circle.cjs` covers the rims, on a washer made by `test/fixtures/make-ring.cjs` (Ø40 outside, Ø20 bore, 6 mm thick, 48 segments, normals written as zero so the plugin has to recompute them). It sweeps the canvas through `_test.pickFeature`, keeps the pixels that snap to a circle and asserts there are exactly two of them, then clicks the bore and reads the corner panel: `直径 Ø 20.0 mm` and `半径 R 10.0 mm`. ```bash env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE -u NODE_OPTIONS test/measure.cjs \ "test/harness.html?file=./fixtures/plates.stl" out.png env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE -u NODE_OPTIONS test/snap-points.cjs \ "test/harness.html?file=./fixtures/plates.stl" out.png env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE -u NODE_OPTIONS test/circle.cjs \ "test/harness.html?file=./fixtures/ring.stl" out.png ``` ## 中文速览 给 DSH 侧边栏加一个 **STL 三维预览**：文件树里点开 `.stl`，右侧面板直接渲染，交互同常规 3D 看图。 ```bash plugin_manager install_bundle target: file:D:/path/to/dsh-stl-viewer ``` - 左键旋转 / 滚轮缩放 / 右键平移 / 双击复位（`R`、`0` 也复位） - 点「测量」（或按 `M`）后光标会像 Bambu Studio 那样吸附到**顶点 / 棱 / 面 / 圆**：两个点的直线距离、点到面的垂直距离、两棱的夹角与间距、两面平行取间距、不平行取夹角 + 最短距离、圆心距等，读数都带 ΔX/ΔY/ΔZ；`Shift` + 点击取任意表面点；拖动仍可旋转，`Esc` 退出 - 悬停圆孔/圆柱的边一圈即整圈选中，**内径与外径是两个独立的圆**可分别点；左上角面板显示 `直径 Ø` 与 `半径 R`，和 Bambu Studio 的读数面板一致 - 二进制与 ASCII STL 都能读；法线逐面重算、双面打光，Z-up 自动立起来 - 相机按包围球自适应，0.6 mm 的钢网和 300 mm 的零件都会铺满面板 - 依赖 dsh-better-sidebar ≥ 0.30.0；没有构建步骤，`lib/client.js` 就是产物 尺寸没有单位（STL 不存单位），大文件整体解析（几十万面约 1–2 秒），`.obj/.glb/.3mf` 不在范围内。 ## License MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE).

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-arcgispro

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![topic: dsh-plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-0e7490)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)
[![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-4d6bfe)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)

让 DeepSeek Harness 直接操作 ArcGIS Pro：1977 个 GP 工具、`.aprx` 工程、地图、图层、布局出图、要素类读写、许可与环境变量。

## 为什么是一个常驻 Python 桥

`import arcpy` 实测 **7–20 秒**（冷启动 20.6s，warm 7.2s），而之后任何一次调用都是 5–40ms。
所以这里不采用「每次执行都 spawn 一个 python」的做法——那样每个工具调用都要付一次 import 成本。
插件启动一个常驻进程，用 JSON Lines 通信，第一次工具调用付一次 import 成本，之后全走热进程。

桥把 **fd1 重定向为协议通道**（`os.dup2(2, 1)`），`sys.stdout` 指向 stderr。
原因：GP 工具会往 stdout 打印中文进度消息，混进协议流就会毁掉 JSON 解析。现在所有 GP 打印都进 stderr，只有协议 JSON 走 fd1。

## 安装

### 方式一：从 npm 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-arcgispro
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-arcgispro
```

`desktop` 是带窗口的 ArcGIS Pro 桌面 profile，`web` 是浏览器 profile；把 profile 名换成你实际要装的那个。
装完刷新页面即生效，插件出现在「设置 → 插件」里，行内标注 **ArcGIS Pro 桥**。
需要宿主里已有 `plugin_manager`（`dsh-base` 自带）。

> 该包当前**尚未发布到 npm**，上面的命令会解析失败。现在要装请用方式二。

### 方式二：从 GitHub 安装（现在可用）

钉住 tag 的 tarball 地址，下载后直接解包安装，不需要 git 传输：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add https://codeload.github.com/haiwenxiang061-dev/dsh-arcgispro/tar.gz/refs/tags/v0.1.0
dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://codeload.github.com/haiwenxiang061-dev/dsh-arcgispro/tar.gz/refs/tags/v0.1.0
```

Release 里也挂了同一份 `.tgz` 附件，想用 GitHub 的下载页可以换成：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/haiwenxiang061-dev/dsh-arcgispro/releases/download/v0.1.0/dsh-arcgispro-0.1.0.tgz
```

两点实测注意：
- `dsh plugin` 会把参数转发给 profile 目录里的 pnpm，所以本机需要能调到 `pnpm`（`npm i -g pnpm` 即可）。
- 不建议用 `github:haiwenxiang061-dev/dsh-arcgispro` 这种简写：它走 git 传输协议，在国内网络下经常被 reset；上面的 codeload 地址走 HTTPS 下载，稳定得多。

### 源码链接安装（开发用）

profile 目录 `C:\Users\下雪了\.dsh\profiles\desktop\`：

```jsonc
// package.json
"dependencies": { "dsh-arcgispro": "file:../../../workplace/dsh-arcgispro" },
"dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [ /* ... */ "dsh-arcgispro" ] } }
```

`node_modules/dsh-arcgispro` 指向源码目录即可（junction 或 symlink 都行）。

Python 定位顺序：配置项 `python` → 环境变量 `DSH_ARCGISPRO_PYTHON` → 注册表 `HKLM\SOFTWARE\ESRI\ArcGISPro` 的 `InstallDir` → 常见安装根目录。
默认环境是 `<InstallDir>\bin\Python\envs\arcgispro-py3\python.exe`。

## 工具（87 个）

**状态与许可**
`arcgis_status`（含 `restart`）· `arcgis_license`（info/checkout/checkin/setProduct）· `arcgis_environment`（读写 74 项 GP 环境变量）

**GP 工具目录**
`arcgis_tool_list` · `arcgis_tool_info` · `arcgis_tool_run`（`params` 按名字 / `args` 按位置二选一）

**任意 arcpy 代码**
`arcgis_python`——在桥进程里执行 Python，命名空间里已备好 `arcpy`、`arcutil` 和当前工程对象 `aprx`，脚本的 `result` 变量与 stdout/stderr 一并带回。
所有工具都盖不住的能力（`arcpy.da` 游标、`arcpy.metadata`、CIM 深度定制、第三方扩展）从这里进；要求 `writeAllowed: true`，无参数校验、无回滚。

**工程 / 地图 / 图层 / 布局**
`arcgis_project_open` · `arcgis_project_info` · `arcgis_project_new` · `arcgis_project_save` · `arcgis_project_close` · `arcgis_project_broken_sources`
`arcgis_map_new` · `arcgis_map_info` · `arcgis_map_add_data` · `arcgis_map_add_basemap` · `arcgis_map_remove_layer` · `arcgis_map_export` · `arcgis_camera_set`
`arcgis_layer_info` · `arcgis_layer_update` · `arcgis_layer_symbology`
`arcgis_layout_list` · `arcgis_layout_info` · `arcgis_layout_new` · `arcgis_layout_page_size` · `arcgis_layout_add_frame` · `arcgis_layout_elements` · `arcgis_layout_text_set` · `arcgis_layout_export`

**地图系列**
`arcgis_mapseries_info` · `arcgis_mapseries_create` · `arcgis_mapseries_export`

**选择**
`arcgis_select_by_attribute` · `arcgis_select_by_location` · `arcgis_select_clear`

**数据**
`arcgis_data_describe` · `arcgis_data_list` · `arcgis_data_fields` · `arcgis_data_query` · `arcgis_data_statistics`
`arcgis_data_insert` · `arcgis_data_update` · `arcgis_data_delete` · `arcgis_data_calculate_field`
`arcgis_data_create_featureclass` · `arcgis_data_create_gdb` · `arcgis_data_create_table` · `arcgis_data_copy`
`arcgis_data_add_field` · `arcgis_data_delete_field` · `arcgis_data_merge` · `arcgis_data_append` · `arcgis_data_dissolve`

**投影与格式转换**
`arcgis_reproject`（矢量与栅格自动分流）· `arcgis_define_projection` · `arcgis_convert_data`（shapefile / json / excel）

**栅格**
`arcgis_raster_info` · `arcgis_raster_resample` · `arcgis_raster_clip` · `arcgis_raster_mosaic`
`arcgis_raster_calculator` · `arcgis_raster_extract_mask` · `arcgis_raster_surface`（slope/aspect/hillshade/contour）

**图层级细操作**
`arcgis_basemap_list` · `arcgis_layer_add`（.lyrx）· `arcgis_layer_move` · `arcgis_layer_group` · `arcgis_layer_toggle` · `arcgis_layer_export`
`arcgis_layer_symbology_apply` · `arcgis_label_info` · `arcgis_label_set`（Arcade 表达式）
`arcgis_table_list` · `arcgis_table_add` · `arcgis_style_list` · `arcgis_colorramp_list` · `arcgis_report_list`

**书签与地图文档**
`arcgis_bookmark_list` · `arcgis_bookmark_create` · `arcgis_bookmark_remove` · `arcgis_bookmark_export` · `arcgis_bookmark_import`
`arcgis_map_definition`（CIM）· `arcgis_map_color_model` · `arcgis_map_reference_scale`

## 典型流程

```
arcgis_tool_info analysis.Buffer        # 先看参数契约，params 的键就是这里的 name
arcgis_tool_run  analysis.Buffer        # params: {in_features, out_feature_class, buffer_distance_or_field}
```

```
arcgis_data_create_gdb      → arcgis_data_create_featureclass → arcgis_data_insert
arcgis_data_query           → 几何字段回 {wkt, type, area, length}
arcgis_tool_run analysis.Buffer → 输出要素类落地
```

```
arcgis_project_open  → arcgis_layer_update（定义查询/可见性）→ arcgis_project_save
                     → arcgis_layout_export（带图例比例尺的正式出图）
```

## 三条设计约束

**改动只在内存，`project_save` 才落盘。** 图层可见性、符号、定义查询、加删数据都作用于内存工程对象。这样一系列操作要么整体保存，要么整体丢弃，不会出现半个状态写进 `.aprx`。

**调用串行。** arcpy 不是线程安全的：`arcpy.env.*`、当前工作空间、许可检出状态、GP 消息缓冲全是进程级全局。桥内部用队列串行化，并发调用会排队而不是互相污染。

**写操作要显式 `writeAllowed: true`。** 磁盘改动（写工程、改数据、删字段、导出文件）必须显式授权，缺了直接拒绝。`arcgis_data_delete` 另有一层：空 `where` 必须再给 `allowAll: true`。

## 实测踩坑（已内建处理）

- **`da.SearchCursor` 传 `Shape` 只返回坐标元组**，必须传 `"SHAPE@"` 才拿几何对象。`arcgis_data_query` 内部按 `Describe().shapeFieldName` 自动换 token，输出字段名保持原样。
- **`ListFeatureClasses` 只接受 2 个位置参数**，工作空间必须走 `arcpy.env.workspace`；`arcgis_data_list` 临时设环境并在 `finally` 还原。
- **`os.path.exists` 对 gdb 内要素类永远假**（`x.gdb/点要素` 不是文件系统路径），存在性判断一律走 `arcpy.Exists`。
- **`Camera` 没有 `spatialReference`**，坐标系取地图对象的。
- **`SimpleRenderer` 没有 `groups`**，符号系统读取要按 `hasattr(renderer, "groups")` 分流。
- **`MapView.exportToPNG` 的宽高是必需位置参数**，`layout.exportToPDF` 不是。
- **GP 消息缓冲是全局残留**：一次失败调用后面会挂着上一条无关的「行计数 = 5」。桥在每次调用前先排空。
- **中文** 全程 UTF-8：路径、要素类名、字段名、属性值、GP 消息。桥进程固定 `PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8`、`PYTHONUTF8=1`，否则 cp936 会把输出毁成乱码。
- **工程搬机器后图层数据源会断链**，`arcgis_map_info` 每个图层带 `dataSource` 与 `dataSourceMissing`，一眼看出哪个没了。
- **`createMap` 在 Pro 3.6 上极慢**：从模板克隆底图工程，实测首次 102–115 秒、再次 56 秒，与有没有网络无关，摘掉底图也省不掉。`arcgis_map_new` 建完会把默认的 `Topographic` 底图摘掉（离线时它必然是断链的），要底图单独调 `arcgis_map_add_basemap`。
- **`MapSeries` 只有 16 个成员**（`clipToIndexFeature / currentPageNumber / enabled / export / exportToPDF / getDefinition / getPageNumberFromName / indexLayer / mapFrame / pageCount / pageNameField / pageRow / refresh / selectedIndexFeatures / setDefinition`），没有 `type / nameField / sortField / startingPageNumber`；`getDefinition()` 必须传 `cim_version`。
- **栅格计算器的 `eval` 不能给空 `__builtins__`**：`arcpy.sa.Raster` 重载了算术运算，`pop * 2` 内部要 `__import__`，空内建直接 `KeyError: '__import__'`。只放计算必需的内建。
- **`SelectLayerByAttribute` 用 `NON_INVERT`，`SelectLayerByLocation` 用 `NOT_INVERT`**，两边不通用，写错报 `ERROR 000800`。
- **`Dissolve` 的 `statistics_fields` 只吃 `[[字段, 统计]]`**，`[{field, stat}]` 报一个指不到参数位置的 `Object: 执行工具时出错`。
- **GP 不建输出目录**，报的却是 `ERROR 000800: 参数无效`。桥在 `gp.execute` 前按 `GetParameterInfo` 的 `direction == Output` 准备好输出容器，输入路径不碰。
- **输出到还不存在的 `.gdb` 报 `ERROR 000210: 无法创建输出`**，而 gdb 不能靠 `makedirs` 造。桥检出路径里的 `.gdb` 就用 `CreateFileGDB` 建出来（父目录一并建）。
- **`arcgis_tool_run` 支持按位置传参**（`args: [...]`，顺序同 `arcgis_tool_info` 的 `index`），与 `params` 二选一。位置传参也会走同一套输出容器准备——早期版本直接 `fn(*args)` 绕过了它，于是同样的输出路径按名字传能成、按位置传就报 000800。
- **`listBasemaps()` / `styles` 返回字符串数组**，`listColorRamps()` / `listReports()` 返回对象。同一族接口两种形状，统一按 `isinstance(x, str)` 分流。
- **`Map.getDefinition("V3")` 返回 CIMMap**：既没有 `toJSON()` 也不是 dict，`arcpy` 的通用序列化会把它折成地图名字符串。真实结构只能按 `dir()` 的公开成员名取（实测 60+ 个：`layers / defaultCamera / referenceScale / colorModel / …`）。`arcgis_map_definition` 默认只回键名，`full: true` 才取全部值。
- **`LabelClass` 只有 6 个成员**（`SQLQuery / expression / getDefinition / setDefinition / name / visible`），字体字号偏移要走 CIM。要素图层默认**没有**标注类，`arcgis_label_set` 会自动 `createLabelClass` 补一个。
- **无窗口工程里分组没法填成员**：`addLayerToGroup(layer, group)` 抛 `ValueError`（内容被包成 `MappingLayerObject` 对象，等于没信息）；`insertLayer(layer, group, "AFTER")` 返回成功但**每次克隆出一个新组**；组的 `setDefinition` 塞 `layers=[layerDef]` 也返回成功而组内仍为空。`arcgis_layer_group` 因此只保证"分组建出来"，返回 `membered: false` + `note` 如实说明。
- **`Map` 没有 `createBookmark`**（只有 `copyBookmark`）。书签只能在有窗口的工程里从视图存；无窗口工程要书签就用 `arcgis_bookmark_import` 导入现成 json。空地图导出书签也会明确报「此地图中不存在书签」。
- **底图名不能想当然**：`addBasemap` 只认在线底图名（Topographic / Streets / Imagery…）。装了天地图插件的机器 `listBasemaps()` 给的是「天地图-地形（CGCS2000）」这类中文名，拿去 `addBasemap` 会被拒。先 `arcgis_basemap_list` 查，加不上时按报错换名字。
- **`Map.moveLayer` 的第一个参数是参照层，第二个才是要移动的层**：真实签名 `moveLayer(reference_layer, move_layer, insert_position='BEFORE')`。顺序写反**不报错**，但会把参照层挪走——症状是 `before` 看起来像 `after`（实测把 `school` 挪到 `Marketplace` 之前，结果变成 `Marketplace, school`）。`insert_position` 只认 `BEFORE`（参照层上方）/ `AFTER`（下方），与内容列表顺序一致。`reference_layer` 传 `None` 直接 `ValueError`（且没有信息），所以"置顶"要拿当前第一层当参照、目标插到它上面。
- **`Map.addTable()` 两个坑叠在一起**：必须传 `arcpy.mp.Table` 对象（传路径字符串只抛一句 `SystemError: ... returned a result with an exception set`，连 `GetMessages()` 都是空的）；而 `Table()` 又只认**反斜杠**路径，传 `F:/x.gdb/表` 报 `SystemError: <class 'MappingTableObject'> returned NULL without setting an exception`。我们内部路径一律正斜杠，所以 `op_table_add` 里要 `source.replace("/", os.sep)`。
- **`removeLayer` 之后 Layer 对象就脱离了地图**，再读 `.name` 直接 `AttributeError: The attribute 'name' is not supported on this instance of Layer`。要报"移除了谁"，名字得在移除**之前**读下来。
- **`arcpy.env` 的写入口收的是 `settings` 对象**（一次能写多项），不是 `name`/`value` 两个字段。工具层传错了会得到一句 `settings 必须是非空对象`，看起来像参数没给——这个错在 `all-tools.mjs` 里才被抓到（之前只测过读）。

## 兼容与权限

| 项 | 值 |
| --- | --- |
| DSH 版本 | 0.2.x，`dsh.bundle.patch` + 导出 `apply(ctx)` |
| 平台 | Windows（arcpy 与 ArcGIS Pro 仅 Windows 版） |
| 外部依赖 | 本机已安装 ArcGIS Pro 3.x；Python 解释器由插件按 `python` 配置 → `DSH_ARCGISPRO_PYTHON` → 注册表 → 常见安装路径自动定位 |
| 权限 | 启动一个常驻 Python 子进程执行 arcpy；写盘与改工程类工具（`arcgis_python`、`arcgis_data_*`、`arcgis_layout_export`、`arcgis_project_save` 等）要求 `writeAllowed: true`，缺省只读 |
| 网络 | 插件自身不联网；只有 ArcGIS 加载在线底图时由 Pro 联网 |
| 许可证 | MIT |

## 测试
```
node test/smoke.mjs                                    # 工具定义契约，秒级
node test/all-tools.mjs                                # 87 个工具逐个真调一遍，约 4 分钟
node test/live.mjs --project <path.aprx>               # 真桥实机，13-21 秒
node test/live-extended.mjs                            # 全能力链路，2-3 分钟（含 createMap 的 ~110s）
```

`all-tools.mjs` 是"有没有哪个工具一调就坏"的兜底：每条用例按顺序造数据、调工具，最后核对**注册的 87 个工具是否都至少成功调用过一次**，漏一个就退出码 1。Pro 本身做不到的事（无窗口工程里 `createBookmark`、空地图导出书签）用 `allowError` 标出来——只要错误说得清楚就算通过，测试要能区分"工具坏了"和"这件事本来就不行"。

`live.mjs` 覆盖：桥启动参数、工具目录检索、中文 gdb 往返、真实工程打开与布局导出、建库→建要素类→插中文点→回读→跑 Buffer、两条写盘闸门拒绝用例。

`live-extended.mjs` 覆盖：建库建表 → 插点 → 复制 → 属性/空间选择 → 投影与重定义 → 转 json → 合并 → 融合 → 点转栅格 → 重采样 → 掩膜裁剪 → 栅格计算 → 坡度 → 掩膜提取 → 镶嵌 → 新建工程/地图/加数据 → 布局新建/改页/加图框/列元素 → 地图系列建/查/逐页导出 → 存盘。断言只记账不抛出，一轮跑完能看到全部失败项。
它会往 `F:/workspace/_aprprobe_ext` 写测试数据（每次用唯一库名，不会撞 ERROR 000258）。

## 许可

MIT。详见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

# dsh-envi

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![topic: dsh-plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-0e7490)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)
[![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-4d6bfe)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)

DeepSeek Harness 的 ENVI 遥感处理插件：**26 个工具，覆盖 295 个 ENVI 任务**，全部走 ENVI 自带的任务引擎（`taskengine.exe`），无人值守、不开窗口、不弹对话框。

本仓库是 ZCode 版 `envi-mcp` 0.8.1 的 **DSH 原生形态移植**。两侧共用同一份上游实现（`upstream/`），只换了宿主接入层：

| | ZCode 版 | 本版（DSH bundle） |
|---|---|---|
| 宿主接入 | `shim.mjs` 造一个假 `ctx` 收集工具 | 不需要：DSH 就是 Cordis 宿主 |
| 对模型暴露 | `server.mjs` stdio JSON-RPC（MCP） | `ctx.tools.register` 直连 |
| 技能 | 目录扫描 `skills/envi/SKILL.md` | `ctx.skills.register` + 目录兜底 |
| 斜杠命令 | `commands/envi-check.md` | 同文件 → user-invocable skill |
| 系统提示 | 无 | `systemPrompt.section`（上游自带） |
| 环境变量 | 无 | `shellEnv.register`（上游自带） |

`shim.mjs` 和 `server.mjs` 在移植中删除：它们存在的唯一理由是把 Cordis 插件伪装成 MCP 服务端。

## 目录结构

```
dsh-envi/
├── index.js              # 入口：转发 lib/index.js 的命名空间（含 default）
├── package.json          # main + exports + dsh.bundle.patch
├── cordis.patch.yml      # bundle 补丁：insert envi 条目
├── lib/index.js          # DSH 侧 apply：工具 + 技能 + 命令
├── upstream/             # 上游实现，原样复用（9 个 lib 模块 + index.js）
├── skills/envi/SKILL.md  # envi 技能正文
├── commands/envi-check.md# /envi-check 命令正文
└── test/                 # 真 Cordis 挂载测试 + 真 ENVI 端到端测试
```

## 安装

### 方式一：从 npm 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-envi
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-envi
```

`desktop` 是带窗口的桌面 profile，`web` 是浏览器 profile；把 profile 名换成你实际要装的那个。
装完刷新页面即生效，插件出现在「设置 → 插件」里，行内标注 **ENVI 遥感处理**。

> 该包当前**尚未发布到 npm**，上面的命令会解析失败。现在要装请用方式二。

### 方式二：从 GitHub 安装（现在可用）

钉住 tag 的 tarball 地址，下载后直接解包安装，不需要 git 传输：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add https://codeload.github.com/haiwenxiang061-dev/dsh-envi/tar.gz/refs/tags/v0.8.1
dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://codeload.github.com/haiwenxiang061-dev/dsh-envi/tar.gz/refs/tags/v0.8.1
```

Release 里也挂了同一份 `.tgz` 附件，想用 GitHub 的下载页可以换成：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/haiwenxiang061-dev/dsh-envi/releases/download/v0.8.1/dsh-envi-0.8.1.tgz
```

两点实测注意：
- `dsh plugin` 会把参数转发给 profile 目录里的 pnpm，所以本机需要能调到 `pnpm`（`npm i -g pnpm` 即可）。
- 不建议用 `github:haiwenxiang061-dev/dsh-envi` 这种简写：它走 git 传输协议，在国内网络下经常被 reset；上面的 codeload 地址走 HTTPS 下载，稳定得多。

### 方式三：加进 profile 的 bundle 栈

在 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>/package.json` 里加依赖和 bundle 条目：

```json
{
  "dependencies": {
    "dsh-envi": "file:../../../workplace/dsh-envi"
  },
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": ["...", "dsh-envi"]
    }
  }
}
```

然后把包链接进 profile 的 `node_modules`（或在 profile 目录跑 `pnpm install`），重启 Harness。
`bundles` 数组末尾的条目最后加载，`envi` 条目由 `cordis.patch.yml` 自动插入。

### 方式四：patch overlay

不改 profile 的 bundle 栈，直接插一条：

```yaml
# envi.yml
- insert:
    - id: envi
      name: 'file:///D:/workplace/dsh-envi/index.js'
```

```bash
dsh <profile> --patch ./envi.yml
```

> **入口必须写成 `…/dsh-envi/index.js`，不能只写目录。** Cordis 用 `import()` 加载条目，
> Node ESM 不支持目录导入，会报 `ERR_UNSUPPORTED_DIR_IMPORT`。

## 配置

```yaml
- id: envi
  name: dsh-envi
  config:
    installDir: 'C:\Program Files\Harris\ENVI56'   # 自动探测失败时才需要
    idlDir: ''                                      # 默认 <installDir>\IDL88
    taskTimeoutMs: 900000                           # 单任务超时，默认 15 分钟
    catalogCacheMs: 60000                           # 任务目录缓存
    scratchDir: ''                                  # 引擎日志目录，Win 默认 F:\workspace
    modelInvocableCommand: false                    # envi-check 是否也进模型目录
    filesystemFallback: true                        # 同时从磁盘发现 skills/ 与 commands/
```

## 实测状态

本机（ENVI 5.6 / IDL 8.8）验证结果：

- `envi_info` → `usable: true`，通道 `taskengine.exe ENVI`，引擎 `C:\Program Files\Harris\ENVI56\IDL88\bin\bin.x86_64\taskengine.exe`
- `envi_tasks` → **295 个任务 / 30 个类别**（经真实 taskengine 拉取，非硬编码）
- Cordis 真实组合挂载：26 个工具 + 2 个技能全部注册，`ctx.dispose()` 干净卸载
- **26 个工具逐个真调 ENVI 验证通过**（`test/coverage.mjs`，30 项断言 / 27 次调用全 PASS）

### 实测发现的 ENVI 硬性限制

这轮全覆盖跑出两条不是本插件能修、但必须提前说清的限制，工具已在调用前拦截并给出可执行的替代做法：

| 场景 | ENVI 行为 | 插件处理 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ExtractExamplesFromRaster` 跑在单波段影像上（如 `bhdemsub.img`） | 报 `Mismatched dimensions between class values and examples`；同一套 ROI 放到 6 波段 `bhtmref.img` 上正常 | `envi_roi_samples` 先查 `NBANDS`，单波段直接 `refused` 并提示改用 `envi_roi_statistics` 或先 `envi_mosaic mode=stack` |
| 阈值型 ROI（`<ThresholdDef>`）提取样本 | 报 `The ROIs do not intersect the raster`，因为 ENVI 按 `<Source>` 惰性求值，区域不会落成像素 | 识别 `<ThresholdDef>` 后换成中文说明，提示用 `envi_roi_create` 列出采样点 |
| 单波段影像算协方差 | 报 `Input raster should have at least two bands to compute covariance` | 原样透出英文原因（属于输入不合规，不是缺陷） |

另外修掉一个移植遗留缺陷：ENVI 头文件 UTM 的 `map info` 末尾常是 `units=Meters` 而非 datum，旧代码把它当 datum 查椭球表失败，导致**普通 UTM 影像也无法建 ROI**；现改为认不出的第 10 项回退 WGS-84。

## 兼容与权限

| 项 | 值 |
| --- | --- |
| DSH 版本 | 0.2.x，`dsh.bundle.patch` + 导出 `apply(ctx)` |
| 平台 | Windows（ENVI 的任务引擎 `taskengine.exe` 仅 Windows 版） |
| 外部依赖 | 本机已安装 ENVI（自带 IDL 运行时）；解释器路径由 `installDir` / `idlDir` 配置或自动探测 |
| 权限 | 以子进程调用 `taskengine.exe` 执行任务；写影像的工具（`envi_subset`、`envi_resample`、`envi_mosaic`、`envi_band_math`、`envi_classify` 等）要求 `writeAllowed: true` |
| 网络 | 不联网 |
| 许可证 | MIT |

## 测试

测试必须用 Harness 自带的 Electron 作为 Node 运行（`@deepseek-ai/*` 位于 `app.asar` 内）：

```bash
cd dsh-envi
ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 "D:/1/DeepSeek Harness.exe" --expose-internals \
  --import ./test/hooks.mjs test/activate.mjs     # 26 工具 + 2 技能
ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 "D:/1/DeepSeek Harness.exe" --expose-internals \
  --import ./test/hooks.mjs test/envi-live.mjs    # 真调 ENVI
ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 "D:/1/DeepSeek Harness.exe" --expose-internals \
  --import ./test/hooks.mjs test/envi-tasks.mjs   # 真拉 295 任务
ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 "D:/1/DeepSeek Harness.exe" --expose-internals \
  --import ./test/hooks.mjs test/coverage.mjs     # 26 个工具逐个真调，全绿才算可用
```

## 工具清单（26）

**能力发现** `envi_info` `envi_tasks` `envi_task_info` `envi_task_run` `envi_task_run_async` `envi_job` `envi_job_kill`

**影像信息** `envi_raster_info` `envi_raster_statistics`

**常用处理** `envi_atmospheric_correction` `envi_subset` `envi_resample` `envi_reproject` `envi_mosaic` `envi_band_math` `envi_spectral_index` `envi_spectral_indexes` `envi_spectral_analysis`

**分类** `envi_classify` `envi_classification_cleanup` `envi_classification_to_vector`

**ROI / 矢量** `envi_roi_create` `envi_roi_from_threshold` `envi_roi_samples` `envi_roi_statistics` `envi_vector_to_roi`

## 许可

MIT。上游实现源自 ZCode `envi-mcp` 0.8.1。

# dsh-prompt-complete

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-2ea44f.svg)](LICENSE)
[![topic: dsh-plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-3b82f6.svg)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)
[![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek-Harness-4d6bfe.svg)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)

「完善提示词」— 一个 DSH 双半插件。点一下输入框右边的**完善**按钮，宿主会读出本对话的历史，把你当前草稿改写成一个完整、精确、可直接发送的提示词，并回填到输入框；12 秒内可撤销。

## 它做什么

- 读当前 session 的 `deriveMessages()`（模型真正看到的消息序列），取最近 24 条 user/assistant 轮次。
- 用**该 session 自己的 provider/model**（`requestHeader().config`）发起一次改写，不需要额外配置模型。
- 改写规则：保留原意图与全部已有约束；把隐含的诉求显式化（目标、现状、要改什么、验收标准、不可触碰的部分）；用对话里的真实事实（路径、报错、决策）消解代词与悬空引用；不臆造路径/API/版本。草稿为空时，依据对话里的未完成工作推断下一条最该发的消息。
- 结果回填输入框，附带**撤销**。

## 安装

### 方式一：从 npm 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-prompt-complete
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-prompt-complete
```

`desktop` 是带窗口的桌面 profile，`web` 是浏览器 profile；把 profile 名换成你实际要装的那个。
装完刷新页面即可在 composer 工具行看到按钮（`conversation.input.right`，order 60），行内标注 **提示词完善**。

> 该包当前**尚未发布到 npm**，上面的命令会解析失败。现在要装请用方式二。

### 方式二：从 GitHub 安装（现在可用）

钉住 tag 的 tarball 地址，下载后直接解包安装，不需要 git 传输：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add https://codeload.github.com/haiwenxiang061-dev/dsh-prompt-complete/tar.gz/refs/tags/v1.0.0
dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://codeload.github.com/haiwenxiang061-dev/dsh-prompt-complete/tar.gz/refs/tags/v1.0.0
```

Release 里也挂了同一份 `.tgz` 附件，想用 GitHub 的下载页可以换成：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/haiwenxiang061-dev/dsh-prompt-complete/releases/download/v1.0.0/dsh-prompt-complete-1.0.0.tgz
```

两点实测注意：
- `dsh plugin` 会把参数转发给 profile 目录里的 pnpm，所以本机需要能调到 `pnpm`（`npm i -g pnpm` 即可）。
- 不建议用 `github:haiwenxiang061-dev/dsh-prompt-complete` 这种简写：它走 git 传输协议，在国内网络下经常被 reset；上面的 codeload 地址走 HTTPS 下载，稳定得多。

> 包名说明：npm 上 `dsh-prompt-refine` 已被另一位维护者占用（功能是「发送前给出 3 条改进建议」，与本插件定位不同），所以这里改名为 `dsh-prompt-complete`，中文名仍为「提示词完善」。

装完宿主半**不会**热重载，改代码后要重启 Harness。用 `plugin_manager` `action=set_plugin` 把 `entryId`（`include:prompt-complete`）先 disable 再 enable 也能生效。

## 结构

```
package.json          # dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client.platform=web
cordis.patch.yml      # - insert: prompt-complete
lib/index.js          # 宿主半：POST /dsh-prompt-complete/refine
client.js             # 客户端半：__ModuleLoader__ 静态 bundle
locale/{en,zh}.json   # meta.title / meta.description
icon.svg
test/pure.test.mjs    # 纯函数单测（转录裁剪 / 结果清洗 / 请求拼装）
test/host.test.mjs    # 宿主半：路由注册 / 斜杠命令 / 同源闸
test/client.test.mjs  # 客户端半：__ModuleLoader__ 加载 / 插槽注册 / 渲染不抛错
```

## 两个入口

**按钮（有界面时）**：composer 工具行右侧的「完善」。点一下 → 读草稿 → 请求宿主 → 回填 → 12 秒内可撤销。

**斜杠命令（无界面时）**：直接发 `/refine 你的草稿`，改写结果作为命令回复返回，不进入对话历史。草稿留空时依据当前对话推断下一条。

两者共用同一条宿主路径、同一套校验，只有出口不同。

## 宿主路由

| 方法 | 路径 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `POST` | `/dsh-prompt-complete/refine` | body `{ sessionId, draft }` → `{ ok, prompt, provider, model, finish, usage }` |
| `GET` | `/dsh-prompt-complete/status` | 存活探测，返回 `{ ok, plugin, build, maxTokens, temperature }` |

两条路由都过同源闸：`Host` 必须是 loopback，`sec-fetch-site` 不能是 `cross-site`，`Origin` 存在时必须与 `Host` 同源。否则 403。请求体上限 256 KiB。

## 配置

宿主半接受可选 `config`（在 `cordis.patch.yml` 的 `config:` 下给）：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: prompt-complete
      name: dsh-prompt-complete
      config:
        maxTokens: 1600
        temperature: 0.2
        timeoutMs: 180000
```

## 失败时

按钮显示错误态并在上方浮出原因，输入框内容**不动**。「完善失败: …」后面是宿主返回的真实错误（例如 `no-model-route`、`empty-completion`、provider 的 failure code）。

## 已知边界

- 输入框里带引用 chip（`occurrences` 非空或处于 `claimed` 阶段）时拒绝执行——整段替换会丢掉 chip。清空后重试。
- 改写是一次额外的模型调用，会花 token。
- 客户端组件包了 error boundary：任何渲染异常只会让按钮消失，不会连累宿主 composer。

## 兼容与权限

| 项 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| DSH | 0.2.0-rc.2 ~ 0.2.x（`engines.dsh` = `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0-0`） |
| Node | >= 22 |
| 平台 | 全平台（不依赖本机 GIS 软件） |
| 网络 | 不联网；只调本机 loopback 上的宿主路由 |
| 权限 | 读当前 session 的对话转录，并用该 session 自己的模型路由发一次请求 |
| 依赖 | 宿主需有 `webServer` 与 `llm` 能力（`dsh-base` 自带） |
| 许可证 | MIT |

## 许可

MIT，详见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-windows-mcp

**English** · [中文](https://github.com/helloHub1212/dsh-windows-mcp/blob/main/README.zh.md)

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-windows-mcp.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-windows-mcp)
[![CI](https://github.com/helloHub1212/dsh-windows-mcp/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/helloHub1212/dsh-windows-mcp/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

**Windows desktop automation for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/sandbaseai/deepseek-harness-handbook)** — lets the DSH agent see your screen and drive your PC.

This plugin connects [CursorTouch/Windows-MCP](https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP) to DSH by mounting one loader row against the **MCP client bridge that already ships inside DeepSeek Harness**. There is no reimplemented protocol client and no second copy of the MCP SDK: the plugin is a *carrier bundle*, and everything you can do comes from the official bridge.

```text
DSH agent
  └─ tool call  mcp__windows__Screenshot
       └─ @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client        (in-box, mounted by this plugin's patch row)
            └─ uvx windows-mcp@0.8.8 serve   (stdio child process)
                 └─ your desktop: UIA tree, Win32 input, screen capture
```

## What it gives the agent

With the plugin installed and Windows-MCP reachable, these tools appear in the tool list:

| Tool | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `mcp__windows__Screenshot` | Capture the screen; the image lands in the conversation as a real attachment |
| `mcp__windows__Snapshot` | Capture an accessibility tree (text, no image tokens) |
| `mcp__windows__DisplayInventory` | Enumerate displays and their geometry |
| `mcp__windows__Click` / `Move` / `Scroll` | Mouse input |
| `mcp__windows__Type` / `Shortcut` | Keyboard input |
| `mcp__windows__Wait` / `WaitFor` | Sleep, or wait until a UI condition holds |
| `mcp__windows__Scrape` | Fetch a web page's content; optionally scrape the active tab's DOM |
| `mcp__windows__MultiSelect` / `MultiEdit` | Batch element selection / batch edits |
| `mcp__windows__Clipboard` | Read and write the clipboard |
| `mcp__windows__Process` | List, start and stop processes |
| `mcp__windows__Notification` | Raise a Windows toast notification |
| `mcp__windows__Registry` | Read and write registry values |
| `mcp__windows__ControlStatus` | Control-loop state. **Cannot be disabled** — upstream force-keeps it |
| `mcp__windows__App` | Launch/switch apps. *Excluded by default* (upstream only supports it reliably on an English Windows install) |
| `mcp__windows__PowerShell` / `FileSystem` | *Excluded by default* — DSH already ships shell and file tools |

Plus one tool of its own, `windows_mcp_doctor`, which explains what is wrong when the `mcp__windows__*` tools are missing.

The composer also gains a **Computer Use** pill, next to the permission control: it shows how many desktop tools are actually registered, and the switch belongs to **the session it is drawn in** — granting it in one chat never hands the desktop to another, and revoking it in one never blinds a second chat that is mid-task. Nothing is persisted: a new session, another window or a restart starts blind (to make new sessions start granted, tick **Grant new sessions by default** under Settings → Desktop → Tool exposure; the pill still overrides it per conversation). It starts **off** — a fresh install never hands the agent your desktop until you switch the pill on yourself.

Switching it off is a hard switch, not a hint. The bridge keeps running, but in that session every `mcp__windows__*` tool leaves the tool list the model sees from the next step on, and a call that still names one is refused at dispatch — live, with no restart. The scope is that session and the subagents it spawns: a subagent inherits its parent's grant, while a forked chat starts blind. Switch it back on and they return immediately; `windows_mcp_doctor` reports the switch for **the current session**.

> **Verified:** Windows 11 + DSH Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2 — the bridged server advertises
> **18 tools** (the 21 upstream tools minus the three excluded here) and is ready
> about 1.5 s after launch. The bridge publishes each as `mcp__windows__<ToolName>`.

## Requirements

- **Windows 10/11.**
- **DeepSeek Harness Desktop** with the in-box `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` bridge (0.2.0-rc.2 or newer).
- **[uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/)** on the `PATH` of the process that runs DSH — **Settings → Desktop** uses it to install Windows-MCP. DSH itself boots without it. `%USERPROFILE%\.local\bin` is searched even when it is not on `PATH`.
- **A model that accepts image input** if you want the agent to actually *see* screenshots.

### Boot is never blocked by the dependency

The bridge row ships **disabled**, on purpose. A `uvx`-style first launch
resolves Windows-MCP's Python dependencies from the package index, and on a slow
or blocked network that resolve can sit inside DSH's startup for minutes — the
window stays on “Loading plugins…”. A plugin must never be able to do that to
its host, so:

- **First boot after installing the bundle:** DSH starts normally, no Windows
  tools yet, and the dependency is reported as *not installed* — both on the
  Plugins page and in **Settings → Desktop**.
- **Install it from Settings → Desktop** (next section). It probes PyPI mirrors,
  installs into the plugin's own toolchain directory, and rewrites the bridge row
  with `disabled: false` and `command:` pointing at the installed executable.
- **Restart DSH once.** From then on the bridge spawns the exe directly — on
  Windows 11 the server is ready about **1.5 s** after launch, with no network.

`uv` is only needed by the installer. On a restricted network, point `uv` at a
mirror once (`%APPDATA%\uv\uv.toml`) and the manual/CLI paths get the same
speed-up:

```toml
default-index = "https://mirrors.aliyun.com/pypi/simple"
```

## Install

The plugin is a normal DSH bundle. Install it with DSH's own plugin manager:

1. Open **DSH Desktop → Settings → Plugins**.
2. Add the bundle, pointing at either the published package name, the repository (`github:helloHub1212/dsh-windows-mcp`), or a local checkout of this repo.
3. **Restart DSH** so the new patch layer is composed at startup.

For non-Electron profiles the CLI does the same thing:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:helloHub1212/dsh-windows-mcp
```

> The Electron app owns the `desktop` profile; the CLI refuses every command against it, including read-only ones. Use the GUI for `desktop`.

### Install the dependency from the app

Windows-MCP itself is a Python program, so the **Dependency** card in **Settings → Desktop** shows its state and installs it for you:

- **Dependency** — `installed 0.8.8`, or *not installed*, or *uv not found*.
- **Download and install** — runs `uv tool install windows-mcp@<pinned>` once (through the fastest mirror), streams the installer output into the page, and offers **Cancel** while it runs.
- When it finishes, the plugin **writes the bridge row into your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` itself** — after a timestamped backup, inside idempotent markers — with `disabled: false` and `command:` pointing at the installed executable. **Restart DSH** to apply that; from then on the bridge launches the exe directly and never resolves a package index during boot.

The block it writes is the row documented under [Pin a local interpreter instead of `uvx`](#pin-a-local-interpreter-instead-of-uvx); delete the marked block to return to the inert, `uvx`-based row. The plugin's own page in **Settings → Plugins** keeps a one-line status that points here, and the activation prompt shown after enabling the bundle offers the same install button.

The page also shows the **Patch target**: the `cordis.patch.yml` a manual write would touch, which is the profile this host booted — including a `dsh --profile web` host. If this package sits in more than one profile and the host does not report which one it started, the plugin writes nothing and says so instead of guessing: set `DSH_WINDOWS_MCP_PROFILE=<profile name>` (or an absolute profile directory) for the process that runs DSH and retry.

### Update Windows-MCP, and roll back

The same page manages the upstream version, so an upgrade never means reinstalling the dependency by hand:

- **It checks by itself.** On boot, and whenever the page asks, the plugin probes the PyPI mirrors, takes the fastest one that answers and reads its `windows-mcp` index. The result is cached for six hours in `$DSH_HOME/dsh-windows-mcp.versions.json`, so restarts do not hammer the network.
- **Versions live side by side.** Every version is installed into its own tool root, `$DSH_HOME/dsh-windows-mcp/toolchain/<version>/windows-mcp`, through `UV_TOOL_DIR`. Activating a version only rewrites the bridge row (backed up, as above): no reinstall, and the previous version stays on disk.
- **Update in one click.** **Update to vX** downloads that version from the fastest mirror that works, verifies the executable and its `dist-info`, then activates it — the panel names the running version and the mirror it came from.
- **Roll back the same way.** **Roll back to vPrev** points the bridge back at the version the active one replaced; nothing is downloaded.

Only managed installs are used by the bridge: it stays disabled until an install (or **Point the bridge at it**) rewrites the row with a real executable, and the panel says which side is live (`uv-tool` vs `managed`).

### Fast mirrors for the Python dependency

The check measures all seven candidates — PyPI plus the USTC, Aliyun, Tencent Cloud, Huawei Cloud, Nanjing University and TUNA mirrors — with a 96 KiB ranged read, and ranks them by throughput. An install uses the fastest mirror that works and falls back to the next one when a mirror fails, with `UV_CONCURRENT_DOWNLOADS=4`, `UV_HTTP_RETRIES=3` and `UV_HTTP_TIMEOUT=600`, because mirrors rate-limit uv's default of eight parallel downloads (HTTP 429). A mirror that has blocked this network is ranked out instead of failing the install; the measured speed is shown per mirror in the panel.

### Settings page and the star button

Everything above, plus a few knobs that do not belong on a plugin card, lives in **Settings → Desktop** — a new entry in the settings sidebar, next to the other plugins' pages:

- **Dependency** — install, reinstall, update, roll back, and a **Point the bridge at it** action, with the live installer log and the patched row's target. The plugin's own page only carries a pointer to this card.
- **Bridge** — `toolCallTimeoutMs`, the screenshot scale, the capture backend, upstream's flash overlay, and the three tools the bridge may exclude (`App`, `PowerShell`, `FileSystem`). These are written into the bridge row of your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (timestamped backup first), so **they apply after DSH restarts**; the page states which row is in effect.
- **Updates** — whether the plugin checks for a newer Windows-MCP on boot, and the mirror policy: `auto` keeps the measured ranking, an explicit mirror pins it, and the official index always stays as the last resort.
- **Tool exposure** — **Grant new sessions by default** (off by default): when checked, a conversation that has not touched the pill yet — new sessions and their subagents included — starts with the desktop granted, and the pill still overrides it per session; unchecked, a grant covers only the session it was switched on in. **Lazy tools** (on by default): the model sees a single `windows_desktop` entry instead of eighteen schemas, calls it, and from the next step the desktop tools it revealed are in the tool table. Turn it off to send every schema on every step.
- **About** — the plugin version, the repository link, and a **Star** button that opens the project on GitHub in a new tab.

Saving is atomic (`$DSH_HOME/dsh-windows-mcp.settings.json`). A value out of range is clamped to its default and reported instead of being written silently, and a change that leaves the bridge row untouched does not rewrite the patch layer at all. **Revert** restores the defaults in the form.

### Lazy tools

Eighteen tool schemas cost context on every step, including the steps where nobody touches the desktop. With lazy tools on (the default), the model is offered one entry:

> `windows_desktop` — *Reveal the Windows desktop capabilities (screenshots, clicking, typing, windows, clipboard, processes) for this session.*

Calling it with no arguments reveals every capability for that session; `{"query": "screenshot"}` or `{"names": ["mcp__windows__Click"]}` narrows it. The definitions come back in the tool result and the revealed tools join the tool table on the next step, so the choice survives until the session ends. A hidden tool that gets called anyway is refused with a hint to reveal first.

Revelation is per session, and the switch is honest both ways: with **Computer Use** off the entry is hidden too, and nothing can be revealed behind the human's back.

### The welcome dialog

The first time the bundle is enabled — and on every later enable from the Plugins page — a **Welcome to the DSH desktop automation plugin** dialog is raised over the whole window: a frosted sheet on a blurred scrim that leaves the app's own DOM and mounts on `document.body`, so nothing in the page can clip or bury it. It says, in three lines, where the dependency (install, update, rollback) and the parameters live (**Settings → Desktop**), and where the **Computer Use** switch is, and it carries a prominent **Star on GitHub** button. Escape, the backdrop or *Got it* dismisses it; focus is trapped inside while it is open, and a CLI/config enable shows it once per browser instead of every time.

## Verify

```text
windows_mcp_doctor
```

Prints the resolved `uv`/`uvx`/`python`, the state of `%USERPROFILE%\.windows-mcp`, the effective bridge row, and the `mcp__windows__*` tools that are actually registered. Then ask the agent:

> Take a screenshot of my desktop and tell me what is on screen.

## Configuration

The defaults live in [`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml). Everything below is set through the `env` block of the `windows-mcp-bridge` row.

| Variable | Default here | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `WINDOWS_MCP_SCREENSHOT_SCALE` | `0.75` | Screenshot downscale, `0.1`–`1.0`. The single biggest lever on image token cost. |
| `WINDOWS_MCP_DISABLE_FLASH` | `1` | Suppresses upstream's orange "control taken over" border on every capture. |
| `WINDOWS_MCP_SCREENSHOT_BACKEND` | `auto` | Capture backend; see upstream docs before overriding. |
| `WINDOWS_MCP_MAX_TREE_ELEMENTS` | `500` | Cap on the accessibility-tree size reported by `Snapshot`. |
| `WINDOWS_MCP_WATCHDOG` | `off` | Upstream watchdog. Off by default because the UIA event pump can take the whole process down ([upstream #332](https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/issues/332)). |
| `ANONYMIZED_TELEMETRY` | `false` | Upstream defaults to **on** (PostHog). This plugin turns it off. |

### Override the row from your profile

Do not edit the plugin's own file — patch the row by id from your profile's
`$DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`, which is composed *after* bundle
rows and therefore wins.

**A patch replaces the whole `config` object; it does not deep-merge it.** The
loader applies overrides as `target[key] = value` (`applyEntryPatches` in
`dsh-app-boot`), so a key you leave out is a key you delete: `serverName` is
required (and names every tool), `transport` is required, `command` is required
for `stdio`, `url` for `streamable-http`. A patch whose `id` does not exist, or
whose `name` does not match, is skipped with a warning instead of failing.

```yaml
# $DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml — the complete row
- id: windows-mcp-bridge
  config:
    serverName: windows
    transport: stdio
    command: uvx
    args: [windows-mcp@0.8.8, serve, --exclude-tools, "App,PowerShell,FileSystem"]
    toolCallTimeoutMs: 120000
    failOnStartupError: false
    reconnect: { enabled: true, initialDelayMs: 500, maxDelayMs: 30000, maxAttempts: 10 }
    env:
      ANONYMIZED_TELEMETRY: "false"
      WINDOWS_MCP_DISABLE_FLASH: "1"
      WINDOWS_MCP_SCREENSHOT_SCALE: "0.5"
```

`--exclude-tools` takes its names as one comma-separated argument
(`"App,PowerShell,FileSystem"`), and `ControlStatus` is always kept — upstream
offers no way to exclude it.

### Pin a local interpreter instead of `uvx`

`uvx` re-resolves the package on every launch. For a reproducible setup, install
it once (`uv tool install windows-mcp`) or use any Python that already has it,
and change `command`/`args` in the complete row above:

```yaml
- id: windows-mcp-bridge
  config:
    serverName: windows
    transport: stdio
    command: windows-mcp          # or C:\...\python.exe with args: [-m, windows_mcp, serve, ...]
    args: [serve, --exclude-tools, "App,PowerShell,FileSystem"]
    toolCallTimeoutMs: 120000
    failOnStartupError: false
    reconnect: { enabled: true, initialDelayMs: 500, maxDelayMs: 30000, maxAttempts: 10 }
    env: { ANONYMIZED_TELEMETRY: "false", WINDOWS_MCP_DISABLE_FLASH: "1", WINDOWS_MCP_SCREENSHOT_SCALE: "0.75" }
```

### Use a long-lived HTTP server instead

Windows-MCP can also run as a background server. Upstream's `windows-mcp install`
registers an ONLOGON scheduled task that serves **streamable-http** on
`127.0.0.1:8000`; switch the row to match — this variant has `url` instead of
`command`/`args`/`env`:

```yaml
- id: windows-mcp-bridge
  config:
    serverName: windows
    transport: streamable-http
    url: http://127.0.0.1:8000/mcp/     # upstream prints this URL, trailing slash included
    toolCallTimeoutMs: 120000
    failOnStartupError: false
    reconnect: { enabled: true, initialDelayMs: 500, maxDelayMs: 30000, maxAttempts: 10 }
```

There is no `env` field in this variant, so the telemetry and flash defaults no
longer apply to the server: start it yourself with `ANONYMIZED_TELEMETRY=false`
and `WINDOWS_MCP_DISABLE_FLASH=1` if you want the same behaviour.

This survives DSH restarts and skips per-launch startup cost, at the price of a
process that outlives the app. Two upstream caveats: `install` binds the
scheduled task to the interpreter it was run from (installing from a temporary
`uvx` environment registers a task pointing at a cache directory that `uv` may
reclaim — install with `uv tool install windows-mcp` or a fixed venv instead),
and non-loopback hosts refuse to start without `--auth-key`/`--oauth-client-id`
or an explicit `--allow-insecure-remote`.

## Troubleshooting

| Symptom | Likely cause and fix |
| --- | --- |
| No `mcp__windows__*` tools at all | Run `windows_mcp_doctor`. On a fresh install that is expected: the bridge ships disabled until you install the dependency from **Settings → Desktop** and restart DSH. If it is installed already, the doctor prints the effective row — look for `disabled` / `command` — and the host log carries `mcp-client(windows)` lines. |
| Tools disappeared after an upgrade | The tool names are `mcp__<serverName>__<tool>`. Changing `serverName` changes every tool name (and breaks the prompt cache prefix). |
| Screenshots come back as text | The active model does not accept image input, or attachments are disabled in your harness configuration. Upstream images are only projected when admission succeeds. |
| `Snapshot` says `No windows found` / `No elements`, and `Move`/`Click`/`Type` report success but nothing happens | Windows UI Automation is failing in this session, not the plugin. Run `windows_mcp_doctor`: its `desktop probe` line measures UI Automation windows and the display scale. This is upstream [CursorTouch/Windows-MCP#607](https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/issues/607) — signing out of Windows (or rebooting) usually restores it, and the durable fix has to come from upstream. The same report explains why absolute coordinates drift on high-DPI displays. |
| `App` tool fails or returns nothing | Upstream documents it as reliable on English Windows installs only; it is excluded by default. |
| DSH takes noticeably longer to boot | The bridge should not cost boot time: it ships `disabled: true` and only starts once an install has pointed it at an executable. A slow boot means some *other* row is resolving a toolchain at boot — check the effective row printed by `windows_mcp_doctor`. |
| Screenshot text is unreadable | Raise `WINDOWS_MCP_SCREENSHOT_SCALE` toward `1.0`; upstream caps captures at 1920×1080. |
| Click lands in the wrong place, or the screenshot is smaller than the screen | The capture is downscaled. `Screenshot` prints `Screenshot Coordinate Scale` when that happens: multiply every image pixel by that factor before passing it to `Click` / `Move` / `Scroll`, or set `WINDOWS_MCP_SCREENSHOT_SCALE` to `1.0` (slower, same pixels as the screen). Upstream offers no dry-run or window constraint for `Click`. |
| Every tool is rejected with `USER_CONTROL` while you use the mouse | Upstream treats any physical input in the last 10 seconds as you taking control back and refuses *all* tools, including `Screenshot` / `Snapshot`, until `wait_seconds` runs out. Keep hands off the mouse and keyboard for about ten seconds. |
| Reinstall fails with `uv exited with code 2` and DSH no longer starts | The bridge was running from the version being reinstalled. Windows locks the running `windows-mcp.exe`, so an in-place reinstall deletes part of the environment and cannot finish. The installer now refuses before uv starts and names the process; switch to another installed version (or disable the bridge), restart DSH, then install. A lock is a local problem and is no longer reported as a mirror failure. |

## Security

This plugin hands the model your mouse, your keyboard, your clipboard, your
processes and your registry. Treat installing it as handing over control of the
desktop session it runs in.

What the design does and does not do:

- **No network exposure by default.** The default row is stdio: a child process
  connected by pipes, not a listening socket.
- **Secret hygiene on the child process.** The bridge starts MCP children from a
  scrubbed environment: variable names matching `KEY|PASSWORD|SECRET|TOKEN` and
  **all** `DSH_*` variables are removed before the configured `env` is merged in.
  Credentials should therefore be passed explicitly through the row's `env`, not
  inherited.
- **No telemetry from this plugin.** Upstream's own PostHog reporting is
  explicitly disabled in the shipped defaults.
- **Remote serving is upstream's problem, not a hidden default.** If you switch
  to HTTP, upstream enforces loopback host filtering and refuses to start on a
  non-loopback address without an auth key.
- **Switch flips are a window decision, not a network one.** Every mutating
  route (`/state`, `/prepare`, `/prepare/cancel`, `/bridge`, `/update`,
  `/settings`) requires the signed session cookie the DSH window receives during
  the launch-token exchange; without it the request is refused with `401`. A
  script, `curl`, or a model with shell access cannot turn desktop control on for
  itself. Reads stay open so pages can render before anything is decided.
- **When the cookie cannot be checked, the plugin says so.** A composition that
  mounts no `connection` service (headless hosts, Electron `file://`) cannot be
  authenticated; `/state` then reports `"gate": {"cookie": "unobservable"}`. In
  that case do not expose the web server on a non-loopback `--host`.
- **Grants never reach the disk — the default does.** The Computer Use switch
  lives in the host's memory, keyed by session, and clears on restart: no file
  records that a conversation was granted, so there is no "write a file, arrive
  pre-authorized" path either (the old `dsh-windows-mcp.state.json` is no longer
  read). What is left on disk is the machine-written patch block and
  `dsh-windows-mcp.settings.json`; an agent that can write those can still change
  how the plugin *boots* — flipping `defaultGrant` on there hands the desktop to
  every conversation that never touched the pill. The cookie gate closes the HTTP
  path, not filesystem trust. If that matters to you, run the desktop on an
  account the agent cannot write to, or do not grant shell access and desktop
  control to the same model.

## How it works

DeepSeek Harness plugins are loader patches, and a patch row may mount a package
that lives inside the Electron `app.asar` — the loader resolves official
`@deepseek-ai/*` names from the Desktop install anchor. Third-party code cannot
`import` those packages, but it *can* name them in a patch, because the mount
happens inside the loader rather than inside plugin code. That is the whole trick
behind this package:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: windows-mcp-plugin
      name: dsh-windows-mcp                  # lib/index.js: doctor tool + startup audit
    - id: windows-mcp-bridge
      name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client"    # in-box bridge, configured for Windows-MCP
      disabled: true                          # inert until an install points it at an exe
      config: { transport: stdio, command: uvx, args: [windows-mcp@0.8.8, serve, ...] }
```

Consequences worth knowing:

- The integration is **version-sensitive** in one direction only: the bridge
  config schema belongs to DSH, not to this plugin. `package.json` declares the
  patch; DSH decides how to read it.
- Image projection is a bridge feature: MCP image blocks are saved as DSH
  attachments and surfaced as native image content. Audio and embedded resources
  degrade to diagnostic text.
- **MCP prompts are not supported** by the bridge (resources are, on demand).

## Development

```powershell
npm install
npm test          # node --test, including a real YAML parse of the patch
npm run check     # node --check lib/index.js
```

To see the composed config without touching a live profile — and without
restarting DSH — use the dump harness:

```powershell
# one-time: a scratch profile with the real profile's node_modules
mkdir  $env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\dtest
copy   $env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop\package.json $env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\dtest\
cmd /c mklink /J $env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\dtest\node_modules $env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules

npm run dump
```

Layout:

```text
cordis.patch.yml      the integration: two insert rows
lib/index.js          host half: routes + windows_mcp_doctor + startup audit (no dependencies)
lib/dependency.js     dependency state, uv invocation, profile bridge-row writer
lib/pypi.js           PyPI index parsing and version maths (pure functions)
lib/mirrors.js        mirror candidates, ranged speed probe, ranking
lib/installs.js       per-version tool roots and the versions state file
lib/updater.js        version manager: check / install / activate / roll back
lib/settings.js       user settings: validation, storage, bridge round-trip
lib/client.js         web half: composer switch, plugin panel, settings page
test/plugin.test.mjs  patch composition + hostile-context + panel tests
test/update.test.mjs  version maths, mirror ranking, isolation and rollback state machine
test/settings.test.mjs  settings validation, bridge round-trip, settings route
scripts/dump-config.mjs  dev helper for composing against a scratch profile
tools/                zero-dependency debug probes (not published to npm)
```

To exercise the update path for real — real mirrors, real `uv`, real profile
write — use the e2e harness:

```powershell
node tools/update-e2e.mjs --check          # probe the mirrors, read the newest stable version
node tools/update-e2e.mjs --install 0.8.8  # download, activate, rewrite the bridge row
node tools/update-e2e.mjs --rollback
```

Contributions are welcome; keep `lib/index.js` free of runtime dependencies and
keep `apply()` throw-proof.

## Credits and license

- [CursorTouch/Windows-MCP](https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP) (MIT) does
  the actual desktop automation. This plugin only wires it up.
- The MCP client bridge is part of DeepSeek Harness and is not redistributed here.
- Not affiliated with DeepSeek or with the Windows-MCP authors.

# DSH Tune **看清审批，减少等待，让长任务有进展、有收尾。** DeepSeek Harness 运行调优插件 · `@herenfor/dsh-tune` [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/%40herenfor%2Fdsh-tune)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@herenfor/dsh-tune) [![Tests](https://github.com/herenfor/dsh-runtime-tuning/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/herenfor/dsh-runtime-tuning/actions/workflows/test.yml) [![MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-25845b)](https://github.com/herenfor/dsh-runtime-tuning/blob/main/LICENSE) [安装](#安装) · [实际效果](#实际效果) · [本次更新](#本次更新) · [已测版本](#已测版本) · [配置文档](https://github.com/herenfor/dsh-runtime-tuning/blob/main/docs/configuration.md)
慢命令放到后台，提问后继续处理其他工作，长时间沉默时提醒汇报，结束前核对任务清单。审批卡和聊天表格也更容易阅读。 **常规功能安装即用；`tuned` 调优预设按需开启。** 本次新增的压缩缓存修复在 `tuned` 中生效。 ## 安装 在对应运行端的 **插件页 → 添加第三方插件** 中填写： ```text @herenfor/dsh-tune ``` WSL / Linux 的 CLI `web` profile 也可使用： ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add @herenfor/dsh-tune ``` 安装或更新后，等当前任务结束，再重启 DSH 并刷新页面。Desktop 和 WSL 桥接端请在各自的插件页操作。[源码安装、旧包迁移 →](https://github.com/herenfor/dsh-runtime-tuning/blob/main/docs/configuration.md#安装) ## 能帮你做什么 | 能力 | 主要变化 | | --- | --- | | 审批更清楚 | 用途与权限两行呈现，保留黄色等待条、原生决定和重要风险告知 | | 等待可继续 | 慢命令转后台，补充任务状态，完成后核对收尾 | | 长任务有反馈 | 非阻塞提问、进展提醒、清单核对及等待兜底 | | 回答更易读 | 表格随消息列宽排版，修复部分答复被折叠的问题 | | 凭据多一道保护 | 检查凭据相关调用，隐藏敏感文件，给工具结果打码 | | `tuned` 压缩缓存 | 沿用同模型主对话的有效推理档位，减少可避免的非缓存输入 | 所有模块均可独立配置。[配置项、默认值和开关 →](https://github.com/herenfor/dsh-runtime-tuning/blob/main/docs/configuration.md#配置) ## 实际效果 ### 审批先看懂，再决定 ![真实审批示例：申请原因、仅本次调用的完整访问权限，以及拒绝和允许一次按钮](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/herenfor/dsh-runtime-tuning/main/.github/assets/approval/create-tuned.png) 上图来自真实会话：**414 字符、11 行命令**对应 **38 字符的申请原因**。模型自行填写原因，用户通过原生按钮决定是否允许。简洁展示不改变授权范围；格式不合格时回退官方展示。 [更多真实截图与兼容验证 →](https://github.com/herenfor/dsh-runtime-tuning/blob/main/docs/approval-examples.md) ### 压缩时复用已有缓存 直接挂载本插件的受控手动压缩对照： | 指标 | 官方默认摘要 | 开启修复 | | --- | ---: | ---: | | 缓存命中率 | 0% | **98.85%** | | 非缓存输入 tokens | 34,055 | **391** | | 摘要费用，包含实际输出 | 基准 | **减少 70.7%** | 这组实验采用同一份合成上下文，分别运行官方摘要器与修复插件。服务端原始用量与适配器统计逐项核对，表中费用由实际输入、输出按公开 API 费率折算。两组总输入均为 34,055 tokens。 [实验环境、方法与数据 →](https://github.com/herenfor/dsh-runtime-tuning/blob/main/docs/compaction-cache.md) 历史前端任务采用同一模型、同一输入和两个新会话做一对 A/B：官方原版对比「整包 + `tuned`」。调优组步数减少约 31%、累计输入含缓存减少约 21%，耗时基本持平。[完整 A/B 记录 →](https://github.com/herenfor/dsh-runtime-tuning/blob/main/docs/ab/2026-11-10-folder-import.md) ## 本次更新 - **压缩缓存修复**：手动、自动压力与溢出恢复共用修复；同模型沿用有效推理档位，独立摘要模型保留自己的配置。 - **兼容原有会话**：旧 `tuned` 预设中的官方摘要器会自动映射到修复实现，保留已有配置和会话绑定。 - **能力不支持时回退**：继承值与显式覆盖都经过模型能力检查；并发会话分别解析，不修改共享 LLM 服务。 当前源码目标版本、实测环境集中见下表。[完整更新记录 →](https://github.com/herenfor/dsh-runtime-tuning/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) ## 可选：开启调优预设 在当前 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 中启用： ```yaml - id: runtime-tuning-preset-tuned disabled: false ``` 然后在会话中选择「调优」。常规插件安装后即可使用；现有会话继续沿用各自记录的预设，`tuned` 会话也保持原有绑定。 如只想关闭压缩档位继承，请**保留 `tuned`**，在其 `compaction-basic` 配置中设 `inheritReasoningEffort: false`，清除显式 `summarizationReasoningEffort` 和逐模型继承覆盖。直接禁用整个预设或卸载插件前，应先迁移仍绑定它的会话。[详细配置与回退 →](https://github.com/herenfor/dsh-runtime-tuning/blob/main/docs/configuration.md#上下文压缩推理档位修复compaction-effort) ## 已测版本 **源码目标包：`@herenfor/dsh-tune@0.2.18`。** npm 徽章显示 registry 当前已发布版本；安装前可在 [npm 版本页](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@herenfor/dsh-tune?activeTab=versions)核对。 | 验证项目 | DSH 版本 | 环境与已验证范围 | | --- | --- | --- | | 本次压缩修复与升级 | **0.2.2-rc.3** | Linux / WSL，Node.js **24.22.2**；压缩、能力回退、并发与旧会话升级，另有真实服务端手动对照 | | 既有审批执行兼容 | **0.2.2-rc.2、0.2.2-rc.3** | 官方执行契约、原生决定、格式回退与批准后参数检查 | | 既有审批与表格页面 | **0.2.2-rc.3** | Web + Chromium；实际卡片、深浅色、窄窗及键鼠交互；CUA 为测试桩 | | 历史真实 Web 会话 | **0.2.2-rc.1、0.2.2-rc.2** | Windows / WSL；Node.js **22.23.4**；历史 Web 功能、调优预设和显示设置验证 | **本次自动检查：160 项，154 通过、6 跳过、0 失败。** 同时完成打包离线安装和旧预设升级检查。 安装版本范围：**`>=0.2.2-rc.1 <0.3.0-0`**。测试使用交互式 Web profile，浏览器为 Chromium；审批中的 CUA 由测试桩提供，压缩实验通过官方模块与真实模型服务运行。 [审批与表格详细范围](https://github.com/herenfor/dsh-runtime-tuning/blob/main/docs/visual-verification.md) · [压缩实验详细范围](https://github.com/herenfor/dsh-runtime-tuning/blob/main/docs/compaction-cache.md) ## 配置、排错与卸载 | 你想做什么 | 去哪里看 | | --- | --- | | 调整等待、提醒、凭据保护或压缩选项 | [配置项与默认值](https://github.com/herenfor/dsh-runtime-tuning/blob/main/docs/configuration.md#配置) | | 从旧 GitHub / link 安装迁移 | [安装与迁移](https://github.com/herenfor/dsh-runtime-tuning/blob/main/docs/configuration.md#安装)；旧包名链接可继续使用，避免同时启用两份 | | 查运行日志 | `$DSH_HOME/logs/dsh-runtime-tuning/`，默认 `~/.dsh/logs/dsh-runtime-tuning/` | | 卸载或退出调优预设 | [卸载步骤](https://github.com/herenfor/dsh-runtime-tuning/blob/main/docs/configuration.md#卸载)；先处理仍绑定 `tuned` 的会话 | | 查看设计依据 | [设计记录](https://github.com/herenfor/dsh-runtime-tuning/blob/main/docs/design-notes.md) | 凭据保护作用于工具调用、工具结果和配置的敏感文件；审批保留原生权限检查与用户决定。各模块的运行方式和适配细节见配置文档。 审批提醒、托盘启动和崩溃防护是另一个插件：[DSH Sentinel](https://github.com/herenfor/dsh-sentinel)。 ## 开发与发布 ```bash npm test npm run check:package npm run check:preset-upgrade -- /path/to/dsh ``` 仓库名保留为 `dsh-runtime-tuning`，npm 包名为 `@herenfor/dsh-tune`。[发布命令与版本管理 →](https://github.com/herenfor/dsh-runtime-tuning/blob/main/docs/publishing.md) [MIT License](https://github.com/herenfor/dsh-runtime-tuning/blob/main/LICENSE)

# dsh-wsl **Run DeepSeek Harness tasks in WSL from the Windows Desktop window** [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@herenfor/dsh-wsl?label=npm&color=cb3837)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@herenfor/dsh-wsl) ![DSH 0.2.x](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-0.2.x-4d6bfe) ![beta](https://img.shields.io/badge/status-beta-orange) [![MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-2ea44f)](LICENSE) English · [中文](README.zh.md)
![The new-task page: the sidebar lists Windows and WSL tasks together, the run location is picked under the input box; the desktop pet in the corner is a plugin installed in WSL](docs/screenshots/home-en.webp) Screenshots from a test environment, for illustration only. The third-party plugins shown are listed under "Screenshot credits" at the end. ## Highlights - **Run location per folder**: switch between Windows and WSL under the input box; folders inside WSL run in WSL by themselves. - **One window for both sides**: the sidebar, scheduled tasks and the choices in Settings list Windows and WSL together. - **Linux plugins just work**: plugins installed in WSL, including ones that change the interface, work in the Desktop window, and have their own WSL tab on the Plugins page. - **Credentials stay out of WSL**: WSL tasks get model credentials from Desktop; nothing is written to the WSL disk. - **No official code changed**: built only from plugins and external components, starting and stopping with Desktop. ## Screenshots

Pick the run location under the input box
First-run setup: reuse your own dsh or use a copy of its own

The WSL tab on the Plugins page
DS Bot installed in WSL, with its own interface working in the Desktop window
## Quick start **Install `@herenfor/dsh-wsl` in Windows Desktop only. It deploys the WSL companion, `dsh-wsl-agent`, automatically; do not install a second bridge inside WSL.** 1. Desktop → Plugins → Add plugin → Install a third-party plugin, enter `@herenfor/dsh-wsl` and install. 2. Quit Desktop completely (in the system tray too), wait at least 5 seconds, then open it again. 3. On the new-task page, switch the run location under the input box to WSL and follow the "Set up the WSL environment" window. Reuse mode detects DSH on PATH and in common standalone install folders, so an entry usually needs no input. Manual entries are under “Advanced”. Saved pnpm version paths are repaired when the corresponding stable package entry is valid; check again after upgrading to pick up the new version. Needs DSH Desktop 0.2.x on Windows 10 or 11, and WSL 2. Feature details, other ways to install, updates, uninstalling, troubleshooting and known limitations are in the [plugin's README](experiments/mirror/mirror/README.md). ## This update The WSL plugin page now uses **“This profile only”** and **“Follows web”**, with hover explanations of the profiles inside WSL. Sync failures distinguish the completed change in the current profile from a failed update to the source profile. Chinese and English wording are updated together. ## Tested versions Tested with DSH **0.2.2-rc.1, 0.2.2-rc.2 and 0.2.2-rc.3**. The scope differs between records: | Verification | Plugin version | DSH version | Scope | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | Current local candidate | **0.1.14** | **0.2.2-rc.3** | 64 unit tests; real manager and two isolated Hosts for wrong-location rejection, removal recovery, retained sessions and reinstall; Chinese/English label and sync-failure screenshots | | Latest use-side recovery record | **0.1.12** | Desktop / WSL both **0.2.2-rc.3** | Bridge and tuning loaded after configuration repair and restart; `web` was stopped, so creating a session there was not checked online | | Historical native Desktop entry acceptance | **0.1.12-dev.1** | Desktop / WSL both **0.2.2-rc.3** | Automatic discovery, persistent old pnpm entry migration, Host / daemon startup and first-restart connection and task mirroring | | Earlier compatibility work | Earlier releases | **0.2.2-rc.1, 0.2.2-rc.2** | Historical bridge, plugin-mirroring and installation checks | The current local setup uses two isolated Linux Hosts in the Desktop and WSL roles. Browser fixtures drive plugin rows and sync failures, with screenshots checked in Chinese and English. The historical native Desktop record covers entry migration, connection and task mirroring after the first restart, with UI checked through code and state. --- ## How it works ``` Windows WSL Desktop (DSH Host + page) DSH Host (profile desktop-wsl) └ plugin @herenfor/dsh-wsl └ plugin dsh-wsl-agent ├ per-task routing: WSL tasks go to WSL ├ reports WSL's page modules, routes and plugins ├ merges both sides' sidebar, modules, └ credential broker: asks Desktop when needed │ settings └ one wsl.exe connection ◄──────────────► resident daemon, exits 5 s after Desktop closes ``` - Transport: one multiplexed connection over `wsl.exe`'s standard input and output, with a resident process on the WSL side, the same approach as Claude Code Desktop's WSL mode. - Session IDs: WSL sessions and folders carry a `wsl:` prefix on the page; forwarded requests are rewritten by field and by value. - Credentials: never copied into WSL; the WSL side gets a credential broker that asks Desktop when it needs one. - Settings: copied one way into WSL. A setting that names an entry of a list (the default preset, the search service, the default model…) keeps the person's choice, and each side stores it only if it has that entry, otherwise using its own default; machine-only settings such as MCP servers and sandboxes are not copied. The rules and trade-offs are in [docs/cross-host-rules.md](docs/cross-host-rules.md) (Chinese). - Lists across both sides: scheduled tasks, presets, models and similar lists merge both sides; a call on one entry goes back to its side by its ID prefix. ## Repository layout | Path | Contents | |---|---| | `experiments/mirror/mirror/` | The Desktop-side plugin, the package published to npm: routing, merging, the setup window, the WSL plugins tab, page code in `client.js` | | `experiments/mirror/agent/` | The WSL-side plugin `dsh-wsl-agent`, carried into WSL by the Desktop-side plugin | | `experiments/transport/` | The `wsl.exe` connection: multiplexing (`mux.mjs`), the Desktop end (`client.mjs`), the WSL daemon (`daemon.mjs`) | | `experiments/mirror/tests/` | Unit tests | | `scripts/release.sh` | Releases a version (see below) | | `scripts/assemble.sh` | Copies transport and agent into the plugin package | | `.github/workflows/publish.yml` | Publishes to npm when a version tag is pushed | | `scripts/sync-windows.sh` | Development: assembles, then copies the package into a Windows test folder | | `dev/` | Test environment for development: a `dsh web` on Linux standing in for Desktop, a fake `wsl.exe`, screenshot tools; see [dev/README.md](dev/README.md) (in Chinese) | | `docs/` | Design and experiment notes (in Chinese) | | `CLAUDE.md` | For an agent taking over: status, entry points, rules (in Chinese) | ## Development ```bash node --test experiments/mirror/tests/*.test.mjs ``` ### Releasing ```bash scripts/release.sh 0.1.1 --dry-run # tests, assembles, checks the package contents; changes nothing scripts/release.sh 0.1.1 # then sets the version, commits, tags v0.1.1 and pushes ``` The pushed tag starts `.github/workflows/publish.yml`, which runs the tests, checks that the tag matches the version and that the package carries the current bridge files, and publishes to npm with npm trusted publishing (no npm token stored in GitHub). A version with a pre-release part (`0.2.0-beta.1`) goes to the npm tag `next`. Installed copies are updated by their users from the Plugins page; nothing updates in the background. The workflow publishes only once the package's trusted publisher is set on npmjs.com (settings of `@herenfor/dsh-wsl`: GitHub Actions, repository `herenfor/dsh-wsl`, workflow `publish.yml`). Until then, or to publish from your own machine, use `scripts/release.sh --local` after `npm login`: it publishes, waits until the version is live (approve it on npmjs.com if npm staged it for 2FA approval), then commits, tags and pushes. A failed run changes nothing and can simply be run again. `scripts/assemble.sh` copies the latest `experiments/transport` and `experiments/mirror/agent` files into the package; the release script runs it. `scripts/sync-windows.sh` is for development: it also copies the package into a Windows test folder you name, which a Desktop links to. For end-to-end tests the test environment in `dev/` is usually enough. ## Documents (in Chinese) - [docs/bridge-plan.md](docs/bridge-plan.md): the bridge (transport, deployment, per-session routing). - [docs/session-routing.md](docs/session-routing.md): per-session routing; each task runs in Windows or WSL, and the sidebar lists both. - [docs/plugin-management.md](docs/plugin-management.md): plugin management and the page mirror. - [docs/panel.md](docs/panel.md): the Plugins page (now separate Windows and WSL tabs). - [docs/credentials.md](docs/credentials.md): how WSL sessions use Desktop's credentials. - [docs/deployment.md](docs/deployment.md): first-run setup, version rules, plugin self-update, interface language. - [docs/cross-host-scan.md](docs/cross-host-scan.md) and [docs/cross-host-rules.md](docs/cross-host-rules.md): the scan for differences between the two sides, and the rules that settle them, compared with VS Code Remote and Claude Code. ## Screenshot credits Screenshots from a test environment, for illustration only. Third-party plugins shown: the desktop pet [dsh-pet](https://github.com/PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet) (PC2005-cloud; code MIT, character art not for commercial use), [DS Bot](https://github.com/Fei2411/DS-Bot) (Fei2411, Apache-2.0), [Claude Code Style](https://github.com/Nwflower/dsh-claude-style) (Nwflower, MIT) and [dsh-runtime-tuning](https://github.com/herenfor/dsh-runtime-tuning) (MIT). Names and artwork belong to their authors. In the DS Bot screenshot, the replies come from a local stand-in model used for testing; the system details in the table are the real output of the command run in WSL. ## License MIT, see [LICENSE](LICENSE). The ID field table in `experiments/mirror/mirror/ids.mjs` is adapted from [dsh-ssh-workspaces](https://github.com/czp0312/dsh-ssh-workspace) (MIT); its copyright notice ships with the plugin package (`experiments/mirror/mirror/LICENSE`).
